neighbours.label: A baby or small child introduced with 'a' ('a baby in a manger', 'a little boy', 'a young girl'), firing on 'baby/boy/girl' or 'little/young'; adults in the same frames stay quiet.
fire: The nurse handed her a baby wrapped in a blanket.
I met a little girl who sold lemonade.
The song is about a baby born on a cold night.
A little boy waved at the train.
They adopted a baby from the orphanage.
The painting shows a young boy with a dog.
There was a toddler asleep in the pram.
A little girl found the lost kitten.
quiet: The nurse handed her a file wrapped in a folder.
I met an old woman who sold lemonade.
The song is about a soldier born on a cold night.
An old man waved at the train.
They adopted a dog from the shelter.
The painting shows an old farmer with a dog.
There was a parcel left in the hall.
A neighbour found the lost kitten.

notes: Card: ' little' x4, ' boy' x3, ' young' x3, ' a' x2, ' guy' x2, ' baby' (Memories of a⟦ little⟧ boy; a young⟦ boy⟧; a⟦ baby⟧ that changed everything; a⟦ young⟧ German monk). Exploratory probe: 'a baby in a manger' 0.75, 'a little boy' 0.22, 'a young monk' 0.15; 'an old man' 0.10.
